children: Ethena posted a 64-character hexadecimal hash on October 4 without any accompanying explanation. According to Foresight News, crypto projects often use this method to make a commitment by publishing a hash of upcoming content before revealing the original text later.
Anyone can recalculate the hash from the original text and compare it with the published version to verify that the content was determined in advance.

title: Ethena Posts 64-Character Hex Hash on October 4
